description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Critical Damage +50%], [Awoken Sharpshooter], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Smart Archer Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Sharpshooter
description.text: Sharpshooter abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Sharpshooter abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Critical Damage +50%
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Smart Archer Mode
description.text: Instant cast speed for Sharpshooter Abilities, Casts Tri-Shot Follow-Up after using Sharpshooter Abilities, removed after using 3 Sharpshooter abilities

description.name: Tri-Shot Follow-Up
description.text: One single ranged attack (3.42) capped at 99999, 100% hit rate
